review_scope: Reviewed all 23 counter candidate captures against the published d919106ac main frames. Technical review covers material presence, geometry and appearance under fixture lighting. Small mail-bank and watch-station text remains difficult to read. Owner play and artistic acceptance remain open.

images.observation: Floor grain, table, radio and companion retain their silhouettes and the colored floor patch remains visible.
The circular beam crosses the tile courses continuously and retains the curtain and companion edges.
Resident, red rug, valve and blind remain in the same framing. The floor and pendant are intact.
The chair, table, shelving and piano keep their edges, and the patch around the window still reaches the floor.
The candidate beam fills more of the worn upper wall. Cabinet, sink frame and floor remain visible.
Gauge face, pipes and contrasting boiler panels retain their outlines against the dark walls.
The book spines and open shelf edges remain discernible behind the chair. The umbrella and door retain their silhouettes.
Tile courses join correctly through the corner. The vertical pipe and toilet fitting are visible.
Dark brick courses and seams remain just visible at this exposure, as in main.
The inside of the open cover catches more light. The fuse row, conduit and enclosure remain clearly defined.
The dark under-furniture view retains the tile grid, worn crossbar and angled framing.
The red ornament and portrait remain faintly visible against the green wall.
The red framing, picture frames and glass silhouettes retain their geometry and warm spill.
Slots, brass fronts and labels remain visible in silhouette. The small text is still difficult to read.
Radiator fins and valve silhouette remain intact beneath the blinds and drapes.
Guardrail bars, ceiling conduits and landing trim remain continuous in the stair head view.
The tank body, ring rail and skyline silhouettes remain visible under the same cloud framing.
The green status light, counter legs and floorboard lines remain visible beside the wall chart.
The cream lid, black mounting hardware and tile joins show no apparent gaps.
The colored residue reads distinct from the floor and the lit radiator remains visible.
Upright tendrils remain distinct against the radiator and the spot extends onto the same floorboards. The foreground cover stays dark.
The toaster face catches more light. Its crumbs, kettle, tins and mottled tabletop remain visible.
The wall and small brass reflections are a little brighter. The housing stays visible and the tag is still hard to read.
